title: The Summit of Mount Kessler
author: Oscar Thornbury
blurb: Noor Oyelaran, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
